title: Beach Bungalow Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Bungalow is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Experience true Gulf-front living at Beach Bungalow, an iconic Seagrove Beach retreat combining timeless coastal character with modern comfort. Originally built in 1953 as one of the earliest homes on Scenic 30A, this beautifully renovated three-bedroom, two-bathroom residence offers a perfect blend of history, elegance, and effortless relaxation. With its thoughtfully designed space and direct beach access, this classic coastal haven accommodates up to eight guests and provides everything needed for an unforgettable 30A escape.Property Highlights Gulf Front Direct Beach Access 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 3 Vehicles Outdoor Couch and Umbrella Lounge Gas Grill Convenient Location to Local Restaurants and Shops 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Square Experience the Home Step into Beach Bungalow, where the serenity of the Gulf meets laid-back sophistication. The open-concept main living area welcomes guests with plush white couches, warm coastal tones, and large windows framing sweeping views of the emerald waters. Whether gathered for a movie night or enjoying quiet conversation, this inviting space offers comfort and connection in every corner. The kitchen combines modern convenience with coastal charm, featuring stainless-steel appliances, quartz countertops, and casual bar seating, ideal for preparing family meals or quick breakfasts before heading to the beach. The primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a king bed and private bathroom featuring a shower/tub combination. Down the hall, a queen guest bedroom and a spacious bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk sets share a bathroom with a walk-in shower. Each space is designed for comfort, making it easy for families or groups to unwind together. The Gulf-front porch is the heart of this home. Furnished with a large outdoor couch and shaded by custom umbrellas, it’s the perfect setting for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, or peaceful afternoons listening to the waves. With its direct beach access just steps away, guests can enjoy the best of Seagrove Beach at their own pace. Included with your stay are four adult bikes, perfect for exploring nearby dining and shopping or taking a quick ride to Seaside’s Central Square just five minutes away.Sleeping Arrangements Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Kitchen Living Room Life in Seagrove Beach Located directly on the Gulf, Beach Bungalow places guests' steps from the surf and minutes from the vibrant dining and shopping of Seaside and Seagrove. With panoramic views, direct beach access, and easy coastal living, this home offers a peaceful retreat steeped in 30A tradition, perfect for families seeking authentic beachfront relaxation.
